summary: Universal Asset Gateway implemented AND wired: AssetResolverPort + provider-neutral DTOs in core; adapters (local/internet/mesh api/mesh mcp/future generator), CapabilityMatcher, idempotency cache, execution policy (timeout/retry/circuit breaker/cancellation/concurrency), credential redaction guard and deterministic fakes in providers/windagent_providers/assets; shared download/validation stays in tools/media_assets via injected ports. AssetResolverPort is now wired into the worker composition root (WINDAGENT_ASSET_GATEWAY=1 guard) together with the Phase 6 trust gate, and the durable production workflow's RENDER_ASSETS step resolves every pending IR asset reference through the gateway — quarantined/rejected/errored acquisitions fail the step closed so an untrusted asset never reaches the engine. Director/workflow never call Internet/Mesh/Blender directly (architecture tests).

wiring.composition_root: apps/worker/windagent_worker/composition.py::WorkerContainer._register_asset_gateway (guarded by WINDAGENT_ASSET_GATEWAY=1; local library adapter over WINDAGENT_ASSET_LIBRARY_ROOT; internet adapter REQUIRES_CONFIG until backends injected; MediaAssetTrustGate composed)
wiring.workflow: orchestration/windagent_orchestration/production/step_executor.py::ProductionStepExecutor(asset_gateway=...) — RENDER_ASSETS resolves pending: URIs via AssetResolverPort (discover -> acquire); non-RESOLVED -> step FAILED closed
wiring.trust_gate: tools/windagent_tools/media_assets/trust_gate.py::MediaAssetTrustGate (AssetTrustPort) — content scan + AssetTrustEnforcer; only APPROVE surfaces as RESOLVED
wiring.no_direct_calls: tests/architecture/test_phase5_asset_gateway_architecture.py — providers/assets imports ONLY windagent_core; port leaks no SDK/transport/credential
